text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 232, "unit": "candies", "kind": "count", "span": "232 pieces of individually wrapped candies"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 54, "unit": "candies", "kind": "count", "span": "this bag has 54 red candies"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "twice that amount of orange candies"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "half as many yellow candies as red candies (divisor)"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "orange = 54 * 2 = 108"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q2", "q4"], "out": "s2", "note": "yellow = 54 / 2 = 27"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q2", "s1"], "out": "s3", "note": "red + orange = 54 + 108 = 162"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s3", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "+ yellow = 162 + 27 = 189"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "pink = 232 - 189 = 43"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "number of pink candies in the bag"}, "dismissed": []}
